$comment: Machine-readable index of every effect in this gallery, generated from src/showcase/effects/*.js by scripts/build-effects-index.mjs. Do not hand-edit -- regenerate with `npm run build-effects-index`. Human version: README.md.
sourceProject: Ported from mini-taiwan-pulse's public/showcase/ demo (see README 'What changed during the port').

effects.title: Glow Orb
effects.description: Three stacked spheres: a white core and two colored outer shells, opacity oscillating with sin(t). This is the same pattern used for ship/flight/train blips across Mini Taiwan Pulse.
effects.prompt: Place a [250m] diameter [#6cb8ff] glow orb at [location], three layers (white core, blue shells), breathing pulse every [2s].
effects.tech: Layered IcosahedronGeometry + AdditiveBlending + breathing pulse

effects.title: Cylinder
effects.description: The most basic 3D cylinder. Uniform height = signal tower; wide base, narrow top = lighthouse; base only = flat disc. Set topRadius to 0 to turn it into a cone.
effects.prompt: Erect a [400m] tall, [60m] radius [pale green] cylinder at [location], semi-transparent (opacity 0.5), static.
effects.tech: CylinderGeometry + semi-transparent MeshBasicMaterial

effects.title: Cone / Signal Tower
effects.description: ConeGeometry is CylinderGeometry with topRadius=0. Can express: a signal tower (tip up), radar coverage (tip down), or an umbrella-shaped range.
effects.prompt: Place an inverted (tip-down) [300m] tall, [400m] base-diameter [orange-red] cone at [location] to represent radar coverage, semi-transparent at 0.3.
effects.tech: ConeGeometry -- flipped, it reads as a funnel / radar coverage cone

effects.title: Dome / Half-sphere
effects.description: Cutting a SphereGeometry's angle range in half makes a dome -- useful for stadiums, shields, or a zone of influence. Coloring the inside (BackSide) gives a planetarium-ceiling look.
effects.prompt: Build a [700m] radius [purple] half-dome at [location], 0.25 opacity, double-sided so the inner structure is visible.
effects.tech: SphereGeometry with a phiStart/phiLength cutoff

effects.title: Heart (Custom Shape Extrude)
effects.description: The Shape API can draw any 2D outline (heart, star, logo, an administrative-boundary silhouette), then ExtrudeGeometry pushes it into 3D. Good fit for special locations, holidays, or brand markers.
effects.prompt: Float a [red] heart (Shape + Extrude, 80m thick) [600m] above [location], slowly spinning around the Z axis with a breathing pulse.
effects.tech: THREE.Shape + bezierCurveTo draws a 2D heart -> ExtrudeGeometry gives it depth

effects.title: Five-pointed Star (Extrude)
effects.description: 10 points alternating between an outer and inner radius make a five-pointed star. Change the point count for an eight- or twelve-pointed star; change the outer/inner ratio for skinnier or fatter points. Good for ratings, favorites, or hot POIs.
effects.prompt: Float a [yellow] five-pointed star (outer radius 700m, inner radius 280m) above [location], slow spin with a breathing pulse.
effects.tech: 10 alternating Vector2 points form a Shape, then ExtrudeGeometry

effects.title: 3D Pin Marker (Google Maps style)
effects.description: The classic map marker: a sphere on top, a pointed cone at the bottom, and a white dot in the center. Instantly recognizable from Google Maps / Apple Maps. Add a bounce to signal 'new notification'.
effects.prompt: Plant a [red] pin (300m tall) at [location], pointed tip touching the ground, sphere head with a white center dot, bouncing once per second.
effects.tech: An inverted Cone + a Sphere (head) + a white dot, the whole thing can bounce

effects.title: Crystal (Polyhedron)
effects.description: A built-in polyhedron plus a wireframe overlay reads as a crystal / gem / abstract logo. Swap `shape` to switch face count. The dual-axis rotation lets you see every face.
effects.prompt: Float a [light blue] octahedron (radius 300m) at 400m altitude above [location], translucent white wireframe inside, slow rotation on both X and Y axes.
effects.tech: Octahedron / Dodecahedron / Icosahedron + a wireframe overlay + dual-axis rotation

effects.title: Light Beam / Laser
effects.description: A thin cylinder + a gradient that fades from bottom to top + AdditiveBlending = a cyberpunk light beam. Stack two layers (a thin core + an outer halo) for extra texture.
effects.prompt: Shoot a [800m] tall, [15m] radius [cyan] light beam up from [location], fading from dense at the bottom to faint at the top, additive blending, with a wider, fainter halo layer around it.
effects.tech: Cylinder + custom fragment shader for a vertical gradient + additive blending

effects.title: Volumetric Light Cone / God Rays
effects.description: Countless rays shooting down from a point in the sky to the ground + a semi-transparent cone shell = god rays, a spotlight, or a UFO beam. The rays can rotate and pulse.
effects.prompt: From a point [1200m] above [location], shoot [20] [pale yellow] rays down onto a ground circle of [600m] radius, the whole thing rotating slowly.
effects.tech: Multiple LineSegments rays from an apex point to a base circle + a semi-transparent cone shell

effects.title: Neon Path
effects.description: A curved tube = a neon sign, a glowing wire, or a light-beam trail. A white inner core + a pink outer halo layered together give a strong glow. Change the curve path for a different shape.
effects.prompt: Draw a [pink] neon curved tube spanning [1500m] at [location], white inner core with a pink outer halo, pulsing once every [0.3s].
effects.tech: TubeGeometry along a CatmullRom curve + a thin inner / wide outer dual-layer AdditiveBlending + breathing pulse

effects.title: Ripple
effects.description: Four rings expand with staggered timing, each growing from small to large and fading from bright to transparent, simulating a water ripple or radar pulse. Great for expressing "an event just happened."
effects.prompt: At [location], emit a [yellow] ripple every [1.5s], expanding to a max radius of [800m] while fading out.
effects.tech: Layered RingGeometry, radius grows over time while opacity fades

effects.title: Radar Sweep
effects.description: Uses the Shape API to draw a fan/wedge shape, rotating it to simulate a radar sweep arm. Add ring gradations for a complete radar UI. Expresses "under surveillance" or "scanning."
effects.prompt: Place a [600m] radius [green] radar at [location], sweep arm width [30°], one full sweep every [3s], with three graduation rings.
effects.tech: Fan-shaped ShapeGeometry + rotation + gradient alpha

effects.title: Rotating Ring
effects.description: Torus is donut-shaped geometry. Tilt + rotation = planetary rings, energy fields, Saturn's rings. Stacking three rings rotating on different axes gives a strong sci-fi feel.
effects.prompt: Place three [400m] radius [gold] rings at [location], each rotating on a different axis simultaneously, with additive blending.
effects.tech: TorusGeometry + continuous rotation + layered stacking

effects.title: Lightning Strike
effects.description: A zigzag line from sky to ground, each segment randomly offset; brightness flashes on suddenly then fades quickly, striking again at random intervals. Expresses a lightning strike, sudden event, warning, or attack.
effects.prompt: Strike [white] lightning at [location] from [1500m] altitude down to the ground, averaging once every [1.5s] (randomly jittered), with a zigzag amplitude of [120m].
effects.tech: Dynamic zigzag Line + random regeneration + brief alpha decay

effects.title: Countdown Ring
effects.description: The torus continuously shrinks from 360° to 0°, looking like a progress ring running in reverse. Expresses a countdown, remaining capacity, cooldown, or progress. The color gradient makes it more intuitive.
effects.prompt: Place a [500m] radius, [60m] thick countdown ring at [location], cycling from full to empty every [10s], color shifting from green through yellow to red.
effects.tech: TorusGeometry + dynamic thetaLength clipping + HSL color shifting from green to red

effects.title: Shockwave
effects.description: More dramatic than a ripple: a pillar shoots up instantly, then a ring bursts outward from its base. Expresses an explosion, warning, energy release, or epicenter.
effects.prompt: At [location], burst once every [3s]: a [500m] tall pink pillar shoots up from the center, with a ring simultaneously expanding to a [1500m] radius.
effects.tech: Central vertical burst pillar + ground-spreading ring, regenerating in sync on a fixed period

effects.title: Contour Lines
effects.description: 8 circles expand with staggered timing, each rising as it expands, with color shifting from yellow to green. Visualizes contour maps, sound wave propagation, or radio coverage.
effects.prompt: At [location], continuously emit [8] contour rings, expanding to a max radius of [1500m] while rising to [300m], color fading from yellow to green.
effects.tech: Layered concentric Lines + radius expanding over time + Z-axis lift + HSL color gradient tied to height

effects.title: Selection Ring
effects.description: A breathing glow sphere at the center plus three gapped rings rotating in opposite directions = an "I'm here!" marker. Expresses target selection, a warning, tracking lock, or a highlighted point of interest.
effects.prompt: Place a [300m] radius selection marker at [location]: a [white] pulsing sphere at the center plus three [pink] gapped rings rotating in opposite directions.
effects.tech: Central pulsing target sphere + 3 asymmetric RingGeometry rings rotating in opposite directions

effects.title: Rainbow Arch
effects.description: A half-circle ring forms an arch. 6 layers of different colors and radii = a rainbow arch. Can be changed to a single color, thickened, or animated flying past to become a takeoff trajectory, a magpie bridge, or a ribbon streamer.
effects.prompt: Erect a [1500m] radius rainbow arch at [location] (six layers: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple), the half-circle arcing upward over the ground.
effects.tech: TorusGeometry with thetaLength=π (half circle) + multiple layers of different colors and radii stacked together

effects.title: Hydro Cycle
effects.description: Cloud -> rain -> lake -> evaporation -> cloud, a light particle loops through the 4-stage cycle. Expresses a natural cycle, life cycle, closed-loop process, or subscription renewal.
effects.prompt: Lay out a [1500m] wide water cycle at [location]: cloud (top) -> rain (right) -> lake (bottom) -> evaporation (left), with [8] light particles looping around.
effects.tech: 4 nodes (cloud/rain/lake/evaporation) + connecting lines + a light particle looping along the path

effects.title: Flood Spread
effects.description: A disc-shaped water surface expands outward and rises upward at the same time, with a bright ring at its edge. Expresses a flooded area, spreading impact, infection propagation, or coverage growth.
effects.prompt: At [location], flood once every [5s]: the water surface expands from 0 to [2000m], water level simultaneously rising from 0 to [200m], with a bright edge ring.
effects.tech: Disc radius expansion + Z-axis rise + bright edge ring, regenerating on a fixed period

effects.title: Feedback Loop
effects.description: 5 nodes linked in a ring, with a looping light particle expressing positive/negative feedback, a dependency cycle, subscription renewal, or process reflux. Change the node count to represent a different order of relationship.
effects.prompt: Lay out a [1200m] wide feedback loop at [location], [5] nodes in a ring, [6] light particles looping clockwise.
effects.tech: 5 nodes arranged in a circle + slightly curved TubeGeometry connections + a light particle looping around

effects.title: Skirt Sway (Vertex Wave)
effects.description: In the vertex shader, each vertex gets a horizontal offset based on "height + time" → the whole shape sways like a jellyfish / sea anemone / curtain in the wind. Displacement amplitude is adjustable.
effects.prompt: Erect a [pink] cylinder at [location] (400m tall, 100m radius), top stays still while the bottom sways up to 30m, like a swaying jellyfish.
effects.tech: Cylinder + vertex shader uses sin(z + time) for horizontal displacement

effects.title: Flowing Gradient
effects.description: Uses sin/sawtooth in the fragment shader to create color bands, with uv offset over time → looks like flowing energy. The same technique can flow horizontally to represent "data transfer".
effects.prompt: Erect a [600m] tall cylinder at [location], with [3] upward-flowing [blue-purple gradient] color bands inside, moving one body-length per second.
effects.tech: Cylinder + fragment shader uses uv.y - time for upward-flowing color bands

effects.title: Aurora Ribbon
effects.description: A long plane floats high in the sky; the vertex shader makes it ripple like a curtain, while gradient color + UV scrolling in the fragment shader = aurora. Change the colors for clouds, haze fronts, or sound waves.
effects.prompt: Lay a [green-purple] ribbon [3500m] long and [700m] tall at [2200m] altitude above [location], rippling side to side + colors scrolling vertically, additive blending.
effects.tech: High-altitude PlaneGeometry + vertex shader sine wave + UV-scrolling color bands

effects.title: Flag Wave
effects.description: A pole plus a flag cloth that ripples in the wind. The vertex shader keeps uv.x=0 (the pole edge) still while uv.x=1 (the free edge) sways the most = a realistic waving-flag feel.
effects.prompt: Erect a [400m] tall flagpole at [location] with a [300m×200m] [red] flag cloth, the free edge swaying widely in the wind.
effects.tech: Cylinder flagpole + PlaneGeometry flag cloth + vertex shader sin displacement growing with uv.x

effects.title: Particle Fountain
effects.description: Each particle has its own speed and lifecycle; when it reaches the top or burns out it respawns at the bottom. Change the direction and it becomes rain, or scatter it in all directions for a firework explosion.
effects.prompt: At [location], shoot up [300] upward [yellow-green] light particles, max height [400m], fading out and respawning at the top.
effects.tech: Points + BufferGeometry with dynamic position updates / respawn

effects.title: Firework Burst
effects.description: Particles burst from a single point in all directions at once, then gravity pulls them down. The whole batch respawns every few seconds for continuous fireworks. Change the color for different festival / alert effects.
effects.prompt: At [location], [500m] up in the sky, every [2s] burst [150] particles outward in all directions + fall under gravity, fading out within 1.5s, random color each time.
effects.tech: InstancedMesh particles + random spherical direction + gravity + synchronized batch respawn

effects.title: Ballistic Motion
effects.description: Multiple balls launch at random initial velocity and trace a parabola under gravity. Can express fountain droplets, ballistic trajectories, projectiles, or falling leaves. Reverse gravity for a buoyancy effect.
effects.prompt: At [location], launch [20] balls at [350m/s] initial speed, random horizontal direction, 30-45 deg elevation angle, gravity [200m/s2], respawning on landing.
effects.tech: Sphere + physics integration (v += g*dt; pos += v*dt) + respawn on landing

effects.title: Tornado
effects.description: Particles are distributed on a spiral cylinder surface, rotating quickly around the center while slowly rising. The radius varying with height determines the shape (funnel / spindle / cylinder). Change the density for a sandstorm / typhoon.
effects.prompt: At [location], spin up a [250]-particle tornado, [1000m] tall, [100m] base diameter and [350m] top diameter, [1.2 rev] per second.
effects.tech: InstancedMesh particles + (cos, sin, z) spiral coordinates + radius linearly varying with height

effects.title: Meteor Trail
effects.description: The head streaks diagonally while glow spheres are laid down along its history behind it. Set gravity to 0 for a bullet / missile; change the head color for a comet. An earlier version of this project's ship blips used a similar structure.
effects.prompt: At [location], launch a [white] meteor from [1500m] altitude, [25] trail particles shrinking and fading, respawning on landing.
effects.tech: A head glow sphere + a shrinking trail of glow spheres behind it + parabolic trajectory + respawn on landing

effects.title: Spiral Galaxy
effects.description: Particles are distributed on spiral arms, rotating faster on the inside and slower on the outside, forming a galactic swirl. Change the arm count for different galaxy types (2, 3, 4 arms). Add a glowing center sphere for a black hole.
effects.prompt: At [location], float a [2000m]-wide [800]-particle spiral galaxy with [4] spiral arms, rotating faster inside and slower outside.
effects.tech: InstancedMesh particles distributed across 4 logarithmic spiral arms + differential rotation (fast inside, slow outside)

effects.title: Falling Particles (Snow / Rain)
effects.description: Particles fall continuously from above and respawn at the top once they hit the ground. Change the color for rain, snow, ash, cherry blossom petals, or confetti. Wind is a sine-wave lateral sway.
effects.prompt: At [location], [1500m] altitude within a [2000m] range, continuously drop [600] white snowflakes with a light side wind sway, respawning after landing.
effects.tech: InstancedMesh particles fall continuously + respawn at the top after hitting the ground + sine-wave wind offset

effects.title: Confetti
effects.description: Colored small planes fall while spinning on their own axes -- party confetti. Feels more 'floaty' than snow because a flat plane has area affected by wind. Expresses celebration, reward, or festivity.
effects.prompt: At [location], [1000m] altitude, drift [120] colored rectangular confetti pieces within range, slowly spinning + drifting with the wind, respawning on landing.
effects.tech: Multiple PlaneGeometry pieces each with their own color + independent rotation axes + gravity fall

effects.title: Black Hole Vortex
effects.description: Particles spiral inward from the outer edge, get pulled into the center, then respawn at the edge -- black hole / vortex / drain. Dark center sphere + surrounding particles speed up as they approach it.
effects.prompt: At [location], build a black hole with a [1500m] radius, [400] [pink] particles spiraling inward, dark core [200m].
effects.tech: Dark center sphere + outer particles spiral inward + respawn at the outer edge on reaching the center

effects.title: Multi-stage Firework (Rise + Burst)
effects.description: More realistic than a single explosion: the rocket rises first -> bursts at the peak -> particles fall and fade -> relaunches with a new color. A complete lifecycle -- a festival fireworks show.
effects.prompt: At [location], every [3s] cycle: rocket rises to [800m] (with trail) -> bursts into [150] particles -> fades out over 1.5s, random color each time.
effects.tech: Stage 1: rocket + trail rising; Stage 2: burst particles + gravity fall

effects.title: Waterfall
effects.description: Particles fall continuously from a narrow region at the top, accelerating and spreading wider as they go down -- a waterfall. Change the color for lava or a mineral flow. The width parameter controls the volume of water.
effects.prompt: At [location], drop [500] pale blue particles from [1500m] altitude, narrow at the top spreading out to [600m] wide at the bottom.
effects.tech: InstancedMesh particles + accelerating fall (life-squared simulates gravity) + spreads wider going down

effects.title: Star Field
effects.description: Random star points covering the sky overhead + a twinkle effect. Add an angular offset to see a Milky Way band. Switch to a lower hemisphere for bioluminescent sea creatures.
effects.prompt: At [location], overhead scatter [1200] star points over a [3000m radius] hemisphere, each twinkling.
effects.tech: InstancedMesh distributed randomly over an upper hemisphere + sine-wave twinkle sizing

effects.title: Cascade Release
effects.description: Water releases tier by tier from a 3-tier reservoir, top to bottom, with particles falling between each tier. Expresses cascading reservoirs, upstream/downstream relationships, cascading processing, or a waterfall pipeline.
effects.prompt: At [location], lay out a [3]-tier cascade, each tier [400m] radius and [200m] tier height, particles falling tier by tier from top to bottom.
effects.tech: 3-tier disc platforms + 3 InstancedMesh particle streams (each with a slight parabolic arc)

effects.title: Evaporation Rise
effects.description: Particles rise slowly from a wide base surface with a slight drift -- water surface evaporation / heat dissipation / a scent drifting. Reverse of falling snow, more diffuse than a tornado, slower and softer than a fountain.
effects.prompt: At [location], from a [1500m] wide base surface, slowly rise [200] fine particles up to [800m] high, fading and growing bigger the higher they go.
effects.tech: InstancedMesh particles rising slowly from a wide base + slight lateral drift + growing bigger going up

effects.title: Flow Line
effects.description: Draws a geographic line with several glowing orbs moving along it to express "data/logistics flow". Density, speed, and direction are all adjustable. The train blips in this project use this exact pattern.
effects.prompt: Draw a [cyan] line from [Keelung] to [Su-ao], with [5] glowing orbs continuously flowing from start to end at [1/8 of the full length per second].
effects.tech: Line geometry + glowing orbs moving along the line (position = lerp between start and end)

effects.title: OD Arc (Bezier Arc)
effects.description: Connects two points with a parabolic arc, arc height scaled by distance. Flights, logistics, money flow, and social connections all use this pattern. Stack multiple arcs to form an O-D matrix.
effects.prompt: Draw a [pink] parabolic arc from [point A] to [point B] (arc height = 30% of distance), with [4] glowing orbs continuously flowing from A to B.
effects.tech: QuadraticBezierCurve3 + glowing orbs along the line (visualizes an O->D pair)

effects.title: Network Web
effects.description: Multiple nodes connected to each other, with pulses traveling along the edges to represent information/logistics/communication flow. Node count, edge density, and propagation speed are all adjustable. Used for social graphs, local networks, or blockchain nodes.
effects.prompt: Lay out [7] nodes at [location] (hexagon + center), fully connect every pair, and have [14] white pulses propagate along the edges at random speeds.
effects.tech: Node orbs + all-pairs connecting lines + pulses propagating along the edges (graph network)

effects.title: 3D Line Chart
effects.description: 12 data points connected into a polyline, with a marker orb at each point. Z height is animated with sin to simulate a time series. Swap in a real data array and this becomes a time-series chart.
effects.prompt: Draw a [12-point] polyline at [location] (total length [2000m]), with [yellow] markers at each point, Z height animating to simulate a time series.
effects.tech: BufferGeometry polyline + small marker orb per node + Z-height driven by sin

effects.title: Watershed Tree
effects.description: A central trunk splits into multiple layers of branches, with pulses flowing from the leaf tips toward the center -- expressing watershed convergence, neural signaling, or signal aggregation. Adjust depth/branches to change the branching density.
effects.prompt: Lay out a watershed tree spanning [1500m] at [location], with [4 directions] each recursing [3 levels] of branches, pulses flowing from the leaf tips back to the center, plus a pulsing core.
effects.tech: Recursively generated tree structure (4 directions x 3 levels) + pulses flowing from the branches toward the center

effects.title: Sankey Flow Ribbon
effects.description: A thick tube between two points, where tube thickness represents flow volume and surface stripes scroll toward the destination -- a "scaled flow" of material/water/capital. The 3D version of a Sankey diagram.
effects.prompt: Draw a [200m] thick [cyan] flow ribbon from [A] to [B], surface stripes scrolling toward the destination, arc height at 20% of distance.
effects.tech: QuadraticBezierCurve3 + TubeGeometry (thickness = flow volume) + shader-animated scrolling stripes

effects.title: Multi-Source Converge
effects.description: Multiple outer sources (6 nodes) converging into a central core, with pulses moving from the periphery toward the center plus a pulsing core. Used for watershed convergence, resource aggregation, or community consolidation.
effects.prompt: Build [6] outer source nodes around a center at [location] spanning [1500m], with [3] pulses continuously flowing inward along each radial line.
effects.tech: 6 outer nodes + a central core + pulses propagating inward along the lines

effects.title: 3D Bar Chart
effects.description: The most basic form of data visualization. Each bar = one value (N periods, N categories), height changes dynamically, color gradients with the value. Can be arranged in a grid to represent matrix data.
effects.prompt: Place [7] side-by-side bars at [location], width [80m], spacing [120m], max height [700m], color gradient from low (blue) to high (red), values fluctuate over time.
effects.tech: BoxGeometry × N + dynamic scale.z + HSL color gradient

effects.title: Heatmap 3D Surface
effects.description: Subdivides a plane into a grid; each vertex's height = value, color = height gradient. Simulates heatmaps, elevation, population density, signal strength. This project's temperature wave layer follows the same pattern.
effects.prompt: Lay a [2500×2500m] heatmap surface at [location], [48×48 subdivisions], height fluctuates dynamically via noise, color gradient from low (blue) to high (red).
effects.tech: High-subdivision PlaneGeometry + per-frame vertex z update + vertex color HSL

effects.title: 3D Pie Chart
effects.description: Uses the cylinder's theta parameters to cut wedges that form a pie. Each wedge can have a different height (dual encoding: angle = proportion / height = value).
effects.prompt: Place a [600m] radius pie at [location], [5] segments (30% 22% 18% 16% 14%), each segment a different color + height extruded by value.
effects.tech: CylinderGeometry thetaStart/thetaLength sliced into wedges + independent height per wedge

effects.title: Block Extrude (Polygon Buildings)
effects.description: Extrudes 2D polygons (administrative districts, building footprints, commercial zones) into 3D. Same concept as this project's reservoir volume / station light-pillar layers. Multiple blocks combine into a city skyline.
effects.prompt: Lay [6] random rectangular polygons at [location], each with height [200-700m], HSL color gradient from low to high, simulating city blocks.
effects.tech: ExtrudeGeometry on Shape polygons -> simulates buildings/extruded zones (same idea as Mapbox fill-extrusion)

effects.title: Audio Waveform
effects.description: A row of bars whose height comes from superposed multi-frequency sin waves (simulating an FFT spectrum). Swap in real Web Audio analyser data and it becomes a music visualizer. Expresses sound, vibration, rhythm.
effects.prompt: Arrange [48] thin side-by-side bars at [location], height from superposed multi-frequency sin waves simulating a waveform, max height [500m], color gradient with amplitude.
effects.tech: Side-by-side BoxGeometry bars + multi-frequency sin superposition simulating a waveform + HSL color

effects.title: Storage Tank
effects.description: A cylindrical container + an inner water-level column + water-level color (low = red, high = green). Expresses reservoir storage volume, oil tanks, battery capacity, or storage-tank progress.
effects.prompt: Erect a [400m] radius, [600m] tall storage tank at [location], water level auto-cycles from 0-100%, low = red, high = green.
effects.tech: Outer wireframe cylinder + inner water-level cylinder (scale.z = fillLevel) + HSL color

effects.title: Connected Vessels
effects.description: Three containers connected at the base; water levels converge toward the mean but with perturbation -- the communicating-vessels principle (Darcy's law). Expresses system equilibrium, cross-region water transfer, energy redistribution.
effects.prompt: Place [3] side-by-side containers at [location], radius [300m], height [500m], connected by a pipe at the base, water levels move together but with perturbation.
effects.tech: 3 side-by-side cylinder tanks + a connecting pipe at the base + water levels each driven by sin but converging toward the mean

effects.title: Capacity Array
effects.description: N containers side by side, each showing an independent water level + color-coded alert. Expresses multi-station status (reservoir clusters, tank farms, battery packs, per-branch KPIs).
effects.prompt: Place [8] side-by-side containers at [location], radius [150m], height [500m], each water level fluctuates independently, low = red, high = green.
effects.tech: N side-by-side cylinders + independent sin-driven water level per tank + HSL color (low = red, high = green)

effects.title: Volumetric Smoke
effects.description: 10-15 semi-transparent spheres stacked together and drifting -> simulates smoke / cloud / pollution spread. Much cheaper than true volumetric rendering, but visually good enough. Change the color to turn it into cloud, fire, or haze.
effects.prompt: Emit [12] soft spheres of radius [350m] in [grayish-white] at [location], slowly drifting upward + slight jitter + fading with altitude, normal blend opacity 0.18.
effects.tech: Multiple soft-edged sphere cluster + random jitter + slow upward drift + grows larger and fades with altitude

effects.title: Noise Cluster
effects.description: Noise functions determine each sphere's position -> an irregular cloud mass. Change the seed for different shapes. The same technique works for nebulae, flame peripheries, or fog fields.
effects.prompt: Scatter [250] small spheres of diameter [80m] at [600m] altitude above [location], positions driven by noise, the whole cluster drifting slowly.
effects.tech: InstancedMesh spheres + positions driven by sin/cos noise function + slow drift

effects.title: Low Fog Layer
effects.description: Thin fog hugging the ground, flattened spheres scattered over a large area. Weaker than smoke, lower than cloud. Conveys morning mist, low-level haze, or a mysterious atmosphere.
effects.prompt: Lay a thin fog layer over a [3000m] range at [200m] altitude above [location], [20] flattened soft spheres scattered, drifting slowly.
effects.tech: Flattened soft-edged sphere cluster + slow low-altitude drift (thinner and closer to the ground than smoke)

effects.title: 3D Text Label (Canvas Texture)
effects.description: Draw any text on a browser canvas -> use it as a texture on a plane -> it becomes a map label. Swap the text, change colors, add a background, add emoji. Simpler than TextGeometry, and any font works.
effects.prompt: Lay an [800m] long label at [location], reading ["Sun Moon Lake"], [white text on a dark background] + pink border, flat on the ground, visible from above.
effects.tech: Draw text on canvas -> CanvasTexture -> Plane (ground label)

effects.title: DNA Double Helix
effects.description: Two symmetric helices with base pairs in between. Expresses genetics, intertwining, double-strand structure. Drop to 1 strand for a spring, change the pitch for a staircase, change the radius for a cable.
effects.prompt: Erect a [1000m] tall, [200m] radius double helix at [location], [5 turns], one base pair every 0.25 turn, the whole thing slowly rotating around the Z axis.
effects.tech: TubeGeometry following a CatmullRomCurve3 helix + short base-pair lines in between

effects.title: Ground Scan Grid
effects.description: Cyberpunk-style base: a ground grid plus a beam sweeping from one side to the other. Add more sweeps with different phases. Expresses area monitoring, AI scanning, map construction, tactical overlays.
effects.prompt: Lay a [2500m] square grid at [location] ([12x12 cells]), a [cyan] beam sweeping from south to north every [3 seconds].
effects.tech: Wireframe grid via LineSegments + one animated sweep LineSegments

effects.title: Energy Shield
effects.description: A triangulated sphere = an energy shield / satellite dish / abstract geometric sculpture. Wireframe pulsing + rotation = sci-fi. Change detail for a denser mesh.
effects.prompt: Cover [location] with a [600m] radius [green] energy shield, triangulated wireframe + semi-transparent fill, slowly rotating around the Z axis with a pulsing wireframe.
effects.tech: IcosahedronGeometry detail=2 + semi-transparent fill + wireframe overlay

effects.title: Hex Grid Wave
effects.description: A hexagonal grid array tiles the ground, with opacity following sin(distance - time) outward from the center = expanding waves. Expresses area analysis, sensor networks, energy fields.
effects.prompt: Lay a [2500m] hex grid array over [location], opacity rippling outward from the center in waves, [1 wave per second].
effects.tech: Hexagon LineLoop x N tiling a disc + distance+time driven per-cell opacity wave

effects.title: Glitch Art
effects.description: Slice a cube into 12 horizontal layers, each periodically offset at random = VHS glitch / signal interference. A must-have for cyber/synthwave/vaporwave styles.
effects.prompt: Erect a [400m] cube at [location], sliced into [12 layers], 8 random-offset bursts per second at intensity [2], alternating three colors.
effects.tech: Sliced BoxGeometry x N stacked + periodic random XY offset + multi-color

effects.title: Floating Checker Tiles
effects.description: A checkerboard ground where each tile's Z rises and falls with sin over time = a rhythmic floating array. Expresses synchronized motion, matrix data, beat visualization.
effects.prompt: Lay an [8x8 checkerboard] at [location] (total side [2000m]), each tile's Z floating with sin, up to [300m] high.
effects.tech: 8x8 PlaneGeometry black/white tiles + Z height driven by sin(r+c+t)

effects.title: Orbiting Satellites
effects.description: A central body with multiple satellites orbiting at different tilt angles = a planetary system, satellite cluster, or atomic model. Change the speed ratio to alter angular momentum.
effects.prompt: Place a [1000m] wide satellite system at [location]: a central [300m] blue body + [5] yellow satellites orbiting at different tilt angles.
effects.tech: Center sphere + 5 satellites each on a tilted orbit + visible orbit rings

effects.title: Drought Cracks
effects.description: Irregular cracks (with branches) radiating from the center, with a pulsing red ring at the center. Expresses drought, cracking ground, a warning zone, or a worsening affected area.
effects.prompt: Lay a [1500m] drought-crack warning over [location] (8 main cracks radiating from the center + random branches), a pulsing red ring at the center, severity 0-1 controls the severity.
effects.tech: Radiating crack lines via random walk from center (with branches) + pulsing center warning ring + severity-driven HSL
